comments.author: kretek90
comments.body_html:
The six .bundle files within the download replace the identically named files at: ContentBackport\bundles\assets\content\items\mods\scopes

Then, the entire folder goes into the user>mods folder within your SPT directory.

comments.author: kretek90
comments.body_html:
To help with confusion

  1. Download, extract & open the ScopeUpdateBackport download. Open the ‘bundles’ folder within the download.

  2. Copy all six .bundle files I.E “scope_base_trijicon_sro.bundle” ETC

  3. Paste all six .bundle files here: SPT>User> Mods> WTTContentBackport>bundles>assets>content>items>mods>scopes

(You should see six identically named .bundle files here, say YES to replacing all)

  1. Now drop the entire ScopeUpdateBackport folder package from the download into SPT>User>Mods
